reply.thought: The task is to pay each customer their net balance (order amounts minus refunds) using net_balance for the figure and record one payout per customer. I need to list the orders first to identify the customers involved and then iterate through them to record the payout using net_balance. Since I don't have the customer list from the initial setup, I must call list_orders() to get the necessary data.

I have listed the orders and identified three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. The task requires me to get the net balance for each customer and record one payout per customer. I will start by getting the net balance for 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme' (38617 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'acme'. After that, I will proceed to 'birch'.
Payout for 'acme' recorded successfully. Next, I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch' (35795 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'birch'. After that, I will proceed to 'cobalt'.
Payout for 'birch' recorded successfully. Finally, I will get the net balance for 'cobalt'.
I have the net balance for 'cobalt' (11416 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'cobalt'. After this, all customers will have been processed, and I can finish the task.
All payouts have been recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I will now generate the final report summarizing the payouts made.
